title: mut.channel_reas_process_18
mutation_directive: Casey Reas — Process Compendium — Process 18 (Software 3) — V&A collection; Process 6, 13, 18 series 2005–2010. VISUAL SIGNATURE: Ink-on-paper density: hundreds of slow circular agents trace overlapping arcs; when two agents touch, a quadrilateral connects their endpoints with growing opacity; over minutes the canvas builds from open scaffold into a dense interlocking tessellated field. Black on white or white on black; oscillates between drawing and architecture. TECHNICAL HOOKS for three.js / GLSL: 2D agent system lifted to 3D: N=400 'Elements' move on the surface of a sphere/torus following circular paths; each tracks distance to others; when within ε, draw a connecting filled quad whose alpha decays/regrows on contact-time. Use additive blending in GLSL. The accumulating quads ARE the visual — never clear the buffer (or fade slowly). Palette: sumi-ink black, single accent. WHY DIVERSE: Pool has no rule-based drawing systems — current pieces evolve geometry, not draw. Reas's emergence-from-touch is a different ontology: the image is a record of agent interactions, not a snapshot of agent state. Stay faithful to the visual signature; pick whatever three.js primitives are needed (Lines2 / InstancedMesh / SphereGeometry / custom ShaderMaterial) — but the FORM should read as if this artist made it. REF: https://reas.com/process
